versions.changelog:
- Initial release of neuro-symbolic-reasoning skill for unified neural (generalizable) and symbolic (verifiable) reasoning.
- Supports parallel inference: symbolic (Horn clause, forward chaining, verifiable) and neural (vector similarity, confidence score).
- Explicit conflict detection and prioritization of verifiable symbolic results, with fallback to neural inferences when needed.
- Suitable for tasks requiring both generalization and auditability, such as relational reasoning, knowledge completion, and trustworthy Q&A.
- Includes an auto-evolving learning system: records usage, errors, user preferences, and provides insights and improvement suggestions for continuous optimization.
